title: skills: teach the action refusals catalogue and its translation keys (after #34273); fix the action.zod.ts index row
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` owed by PR #34719 (Fixes #34273), contract review comment 6947246959 (and nit N4). Dedupe: `action refusals skill`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits #34273) · domain:skills · Blocked-by #34273

## What is owed

- No skill teaches an action's `refusals` catalogue. `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` lists the hook refusal key only. Teach the action declaration, the translation pack keys (`objects.OBJ._actions.ACT.refusals.CODE.message`, `.reasons.REASON.message`, and the same under `globalActions.ACT`) and the localized answer, matching `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`; add or adjust the skill's eval so it exercises the rule.
- N4 — the generated `action.zod.ts` row in `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` no longer names `ActionSchema`; a module doc block on `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` gives the generator a description to print.
